optimizer_param_groups.description: For O1/O2 the model parameters are split into a slot-routing group and a non-slot group. slot-routing = every parameter whose qualified name lies inside a BindingSlots module: slot_keys, W_wk (write addressing), W_rq (read addressing), W_wv (write value), gate (write gate), W_o (slot output), norm (slot pre-norm LayerNorm). All other parameters (token/pos embeddings, window attention Wq/Wk/Wv/Wo, block LayerNorms, FFN, final norm, tied head) are non-slot.
invariants: each parameter appears in exactly one group
group LR/warmup exactly as the arm defines

orthogonal_init_K1.method: Deterministic per-seed orthogonal re-init of each slot_keys tensor ([32,64]) AFTER model construction, in-place: draw a seed-derived Gaussian [32,64], QR-orthonormalize its rows (semi-orthogonal since 32<=64), then row-normalize to unit L2 (matching the baseline which also row-normalizes). Shape/dtype/param-count preserved; keys remain a trainable nn.Parameter; NOT frozen; NO added parameters; read/write equations untouched.
orthogonal_init_K1.baseline_note: The frozen BindingSlots ALREADY orthogonalizes+normalizes at init (32<=64). K1 is a distinct, explicitly-seeded orthogonalization; the initialization audit quantifies the (expected small) change in off-diagonal cosine similarity.

curriculum_C1.phase_1_steps: 1-300: needle only, distance ~ d16, low distractors (pure needle batches at distance=16)
curriculum_C1.phase_2_steps: 301-700: one relevant fact, mixed d16/d96, moderate distractors (70% needle at distance in {16,96}, 30% binding k=2 for interference)
curriculum_C1.phase_3_steps: 701-1200: ORIGINAL ABC_MIX task distribution (frozen train_batch), includes d16/d96/d220 via the standard generators and original distractor behavior
curriculum_C1.example_count_preserved: batch_size 16 every step, 1200 steps -> identical example count to baseline
curriculum_C1.resources: only existing task primitives + the existing corpus/tokenizer; no external data
curriculum_C1.leakage_rule: the supervised target is always only the answer position (mask at pos-1); the value token is never adjacent to the query beyond the designed retrieval distance.

alignment_R1.objective: label-free write-read overlap. Per layer: overlap = sum_m write_weight[m] * read_weight[m]; L_align = -log(mean_overlap + epsilon), epsilon=1e-6.
alignment_R1.write_weight: the slot write-address distribution (softmax over M slots) at the fact's VALUE-token position
alignment_R1.read_weight: the slot read-address distribution (softmax over M slots) at the query position (the position whose output predicts the value)
alignment_R1.signal_source: an auxiliary needle probe batch (B_align=8, mixed d16/d96) drawn each step DURING the alignment window; its cross-entropy is NEVER added to the loss (no output-token supervision). Only the slot-address distributions are used.
alignment_R1.distribution_note: the MAIN objective for R1 uses the ORIGINAL ABC_MIX distribution for all 1200 steps; the alignment term is an ADDED auxiliary loss.
